title: Possessory – Home Inventory & Warranty Tracker
short_description: Keep belongings, receipts and warranty details beautifully organized on your device.
description: Give everything you own a place. Possessory helps you record household belongings by room, attach receipts and photos, track warranty dates and organize maintenance. Core inventory functions work offline and no account is required. Create user-maintained inventory records and choose what to include before exporting. Speech recognition depends on device support and may use a network service. Reports are not insurer-certified valuations. This listing is a draft and must not be published before release validation.
